problem_statement:
For me — a single researcher who has since completed foundational halal-investing education via Musaffa — what becomes true: I have a correct, deterministic, auditable pipeline that (1) ingests real public SEC EDGAR fundamentals and Tiingo EOD total-return price/dividend data for a curated ~100-ticker US equity universe, (2) screens that universe against AAOIFI-style business-activity and 30/30/5 financial-ratio rules, producing a three-state Pure/Mixed/Non-compliant verdict with a full reason trace for every ticker, and (3) lets me backtest long-only, fully-funded, zero-leverage strategies against that screened universe -- including the compliance-flip -> forced-divestment -> purification state machine -- and get back a static report where every number carries its honesty caveats (look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, pending-scholarly-verification) structurally, not as a footnote.

This is explicitly NOT a live-trading system: no real capital, no order routing, no execution. The outcome is a learning and research substrate for me alone -- a foundation solid enough that, once a muamalat scholar with structural-feasibility expertise rules on the still-open fiqh judgment calls (denominator basis, thresholds, purification attribution, etc.), I have real code and real historical results to build on rather than starting from zero. Baseline long-only/halal-screened/no-shorting-derivatives-leverage investing is close to settled-permissible now (per the resolved values position), so this is buildable today; the contested slice -- HFT or daily-profit-seeking trading -- is out of scope for this outcome entirely and stays deferred pending further education.

Grounded in: MASTER_PRD.md §1 (Purpose & Problem Statement), §11 (V1 Definition of Done), §2/§12 (permissibility boundary + deferred scope). No staleness here -- this framing already reflects the post-Musaffa, baseline-long-only-is-buildable position; nothing in it assumes the old contested-HFT framing.
